Glad it's fixed. I saved a hazard memory: invoice PDF tests fail on newer wkhtmltopdf versions unless `--enable-local-file-access` is passed. Anyone who hits this later, for example after an upgrade or on a new machine, will see that note.

Git status was clean when this session started, so your fix may live only on your machine. If the flag isn't set somewhere in the repo, CI and other developers will still hit the failure, and committing it is worth doing.
